```yaml
name: Build macOS Binary

on:
  release:
    types: [published]

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  build-macos:
    runs-on: macos-14
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
          architecture: 'arm64'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install pyinstaller
          if [ -f requirements.txt ]; then pip install -r requirements.txt; fi
          if [ -f pyproject.toml ]; then pip install .; fi

      - name: Build PyInstaller binary
        run: |
          pyinstaller --onefile --name a2a-scanner a2a_scanner/__main__.py
          # Create tar.gz archive
          tar -czf a2a-scanner-macos-arm64.tar.gz dist/a2a-scanner

      - name: Upload artifact to Release
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          TAG_NAME: ${{ github.event.release.tag_name }}
        run: |
          gh release upload "$TAG_NAME" a2a-scanner-macos-arm64.tar.gz --clobber

      - name: Update Homebrew Formula
        env:
          HOMEBREW_TAP_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.HOMEBREW_TAP_TOKEN }}
          TAG_NAME: ${{ github.event.release.tag_name }}
        run: |
          # Calculate SHA256 of the binary inside the archive
          SHA256=$(tar -xOf a2a-scanner-macos-arm64.tar.gz a2a-scanner | shasum -a 256 | awk '{print $1}')
          
          # Remove 'v' prefix if present for version string
          VERSION_CLEAN="${TAG_NAME#v}"
          
          # Clone the homebrew tap
          git clone https://x-access-token:${HOMEBREW_TAP_TOKEN}@github.com/cisco-ai-defense/homebrew-ai-defense.git homebrew-tap
          cd homebrew-tap
          
          # Update the formula
          cat > Formula/a2a-scanner.rb << EOF
          class A2aScanner < Formula
            desc "Cisco AI Defense A2A Scanner"
            homepage "https://github.com/cisco-ai-defense/a2a-scanner"
            url "https://github.com/cisco-ai-defense/a2a-scanner/releases/download/${TAG_NAME}/a2a-scanner-macos-arm64.tar.gz"
            sha256 "${SHA256}"
            license "Apache-2.0"
            
            def install
              bin.install "a2a-scanner"
            end
          end
          EOF
          
          # Commit and push changes
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add Formula/a2a-scanner.rb
          git commit -m "Update a2a-scanner to ${VERSION_CLEAN}"
          git push origin main
```
